14: # DeepStream Import Vision Model
15: 
16: When this skill is active, **read the relevant reference document before starting each phase**. Do not rely on memory — reference documents contain exact script paths, bash variable conventions, log filename contracts, and critical parsing rules.
17: 
18: **Current scope:** Object detection models only. Fail fast on classification, segmentation, or other architectures detected in `config.json`.
19: 
20: ## Pipeline Overview
21: 
22: | Step | Phase | Reference | What it does |
23: |------|-------|-----------|--------------|
24: | 1–3 | Model Acquire | [references/model-acquire.md](references/model-acquire.md) | Browse HF/NGC, detect format, download ONNX or export SafeTensors |
25: | 4–5 | Engine Build  | [references/engine-build.md](references/engine-build.md) | Build dynamic TRT engine, run trtexec BS=1 and BS=MAX_BS |
26: | 6–7 | DS Pipeline   | [references/pipeline-run.md](references/pipeline-run.md) | Custom bbox parser, nvinfer config, single-stream + multi-stream benchmarks |
27: | 8   | Report        | [references/report-generation.md](references/report-generation.md) | 5 charts, HTML, PDF benchmark report |
28: 
29: Run the full pipeline autonomously without pausing for confirmation at each step.
30: 
31: ## Pre-flight Checks
32: 
33: Run before starting:
34: 
35: ```bash
36: # 1. GPU and drivers
37: nvidia-smi
38: 
39: # 2. TensorRT version match (must match between builder and DS runtime)
40: trtexec 2>&1 | head -3
41: dpkg -l | grep libnvinfer-bin
42: 
43: # 3. Shared Python venv — create once, reuse across all models
44: mkdir -p build
45: VENV=build/.venv_optimum
46: if [ ! -x "$VENV/bin/python3" ]; then
47:   python3 -m venv "$VENV"
48:   "$VENV/bin/pip" install --upgrade pip -q
49:   "$VENV/bin/pip" install "optimum[exporters]>=1.20,<2.0" "torch<2.12" \
50:     transformers onnxruntime matplotlib numpy markdown -q
51: fi
52: 
53: # 4. System tools
54: which wkhtmltopdf || apt-get install -y wkhtmltopdf
55: which mediainfo    || apt-get install -y mediainfo
56: which deepstream-app  # required for KITTI dump (Step 6g) and benchmark perf-measurement (Step 7c); shipped with DeepStream SDK
57:

59: if [ -z "$DS_VIDEO" ]; then
60:   [ -f /opt/nvidia/deepstream/deepstream/samples/streams/sample_720p.mp4 ] || \
61:     echo "WARNING: sample_720p.mp4 not found. Install DeepStream samples or set DS_VIDEO=/path/to/your.mp4"
62: fi
63: ```

65: ## Mandatory Output Structure
66: 
67: Create once `MODEL_NAME` is known (Step 1). Never dump files flat.
68: 
69: ```
70: models/{model_name}/
71:   model/           <- ONNX file(s)
72:   parser/          <- .cpp, Makefile, .so
73:   config/          <- nvinfer config, ds-app config, labels.txt
74:   scripts/         <- run helper scripts
75:   benchmarks/
76:     engines/       <- _dynamic_b{MAX_BS}.engine, timing.cache, build logs
77:     b1/            <- trtexec BS=1 log
78:     b{MAX_BS}/     <- trtexec BS=MAX_BS log
79:     ds/            <- DS benchmark logs
80:   reports/         <- benchmark_report.md, .html, .pdf, benchmark_data.json
81:     charts/        <- chart_*.png (5 charts)
82:   samples/         <- output .mp4 or .ogv (theoraenc fallback), test frames
83:     kitti_output/  <- KITTI detection .txt files
84: ```
85: 
86: ```bash
87: mkdir -p models/$MODEL_NAME/{model,parser,config,scripts,benchmarks/engines,benchmarks/ds,reports/charts,samples/kitti_output}
88: ```

90: ## Critical Rules
91: 
92: 1. **Engine naming** — always `{model}_dynamic_b{MAX_BS}.engine`. Never bare `model_dynamic.engine`.
93: 2. **batch_size == num_streams** — in DS runs, `batch-size` and stream count are always equal.
94: 3. **Log filenames are fixed** — `trtexec_b1.log`, `trtexec_b${MAX_BS}.log`, `ds_s${N}_run1.log`, `ds_s${N}_run2.log`. No timestamps. Report generation reads exact paths.
95: 4. **Parser zero-init** — always `NvDsInferObjectDetectionInfo obj = {};`. Required for DeepStream OBB support; bare `obj;` leaves `rotation_angle` uninitialized, causing tilted bounding boxes.
96: 5. **KITTI validation gate** — do NOT proceed to Step 7 if KITTI frame count is zero or detection rate < 90%.
97: 6. **Shared venv** — `build/.venv_optimum` reused across all models. Never create per-model venvs.
98: 7. **trtexec `--noDataTransfers`** — GPU-only compute matches DeepStream's GPU-to-GPU data flow.
99: 8. **Report HTML+PDF** — always use `skills/deepstream-import-vision-model/scripts/report/md-to-html-pdf.py`. Never write a custom HTML generator or call `wkhtmltopdf` directly.
100: 9. **Object detection only** — reject non-detection architectures from `config.json` before building anything.
101: 10. **Encoder fallback (MANDATORY)** — `x264enc` and `openh264enc` are **prohibited**. On NVENC-unavailable systems, use `theoraenc + oggmux` (LGPL; ships in gst-plugins-base; output is `.ogv`). If `theoraenc`/`oggmux` are absent, skip video creation (`DS_SINGLE_STREAM_MODE=skipped`). Report which mode was used: `nvv4l2h264enc` / `theoraenc-fallback` / `skipped`.
102: 11. **Video source (MANDATORY)** — default is always `sample_720p.mp4` (1280×720). Never autonomously substitute `sample_1080p_h264.mp4` or any other file. Only use a different video when the user explicitly provides a path (via `DS_VIDEO` env var or script argument).
103: 
104: ## Pipeline Timing
105: 
106: Wrap every step:
107: 
108: ```bash
109: STEP_START=$(date +%s.%N)
110: # ... step commands ...
111: STEP_END=$(date +%s.%N)
112: STEP_DURATION=$(echo "$STEP_END - $STEP_START" | bc)
113: echo "[Step N] completed in ${STEP_DURATION}s"
114: ```

116: Track `PIPELINE_START` (before Step 1) and `PIPELINE_END` (after Step 8). Report all durations in the benchmark report.

118: ## Report Output (MANDATORY — all 3 formats)
119: 
120: 1. `benchmark_report.md` — markdown source (12 mandatory sections)
121: 2. `benchmark_report.html` — styled HTML (charts base64-inlined, no local file access)
122: 3. `benchmark_report_{model_name}.pdf` — via `md-to-html-pdf.py`; verify charts are embedded by counting `data:image/png` occurrences in the HTML output: `grep -o 'data:image/png' benchmark_report.html | wc -l` should equal 5
123: 
124: Run charts and report scripts with the shared venv active: `source build/.venv_optimum/bin/activate`.

127: 
128: **IMPORTANT**: Read the relevant reference before starting each phase. Do NOT generate code from memory.

134: | [references/pipeline-run.md](references/pipeline-run.md) | Steps 6–7: custom bbox parser, nvinfer config, single-stream validation, KITTI dump, multi-stream benchmark |
135: | [references/report-generation.md](references/report-generation.md) | Step 8: benchmark_data.json, 5 charts, 12-section markdown report, HTML + PDF |

137: ## Scripts
138: 
139: Located in `scripts/`.
140: 
141: | Script | Phase | Purpose |
142: |--------|-------|---------|
143: | `model/hf-list-files.sh` | 1–3 | List HuggingFace repo files |
144: | `model/hf-download-config.sh` | 1–3 | Download config.json from HF |
145: | `model/ngc-list-files.sh` | 1–3 | List NGC model files |
146: | `model/ngc-download.sh` | 1–3 | Download NGC model archive |
147: | `model/safetensors-to-onnx.sh` | 1–3 | Export SafeTensors → ONNX via optimum-cli |
148: | `model/inspect-onnx.py` | 1–5 | Inspect ONNX input/output shapes |
149: | `model/make-static-batch-onnx.py` | 4–5 | Bake batch dim into ONNX |
150: | `model/cleanup.sh` | Any | Remove staging dirs, preserve shared venv |
151: | `engine/benchmark-trtexec.sh` | 4–5 | Run trtexec with standard flags |
152: | `deepstream/ds-single-stream.sh` | 6–7 | Single-stream visual validation (NVENC primary; theoraenc+oggmux fallback; skip if neither) |
153: | `deepstream/ds-sweep.sh` | 6–7 | 2-phase batch size sweep |
154: | `deepstream/benchmark-ds.sh` | 6–7 | Fixed-stream DS benchmark |
155: | `deepstream/ds-kitti-dump.sh` | 6–7 | KITTI detection dump via deepstream-app |
156: | `deepstream/ds-perf-run.sh` | 7 | Step 7c two-run benchmark — wraps `deepstream-app` with `enable-perf-measurement=1`, writes fixed-name log for the report parser |
157: | `deepstream/extract-frame.sh` | 6–7 | Extract sample frames from output video (`.mp4` NVENC path or `.ogv` theoraenc fallback) |
158: | `report/generate-benchmark-charts.py` | 8 | Generate 5 benchmark PNG charts |
159: | `report/md-to-html-pdf.py` | 8 | Markdown → styled HTML → PDF (canonical benchmark report path) |
160: | `report/md-to-pdf.sh` | Any | Markdown → PDF via pandoc/pdflatex — for design docs and references only, NOT for benchmark reports (use md-to-html-pdf.py for those) |
161: | `report/report-style.css` | 8 | CSS for HTML report |
162: | `report/render-mermaid-for-pdf.py` | 8 | Mermaid diagram → PNG |
163: | `report/mermaid-puppeteer.json` | 8 | Vetted Puppeteer config for Mermaid (sandboxed; non-root) |
164: | `report/mermaid-puppeteer-root.json` | 8 | Vetted Puppeteer config for Mermaid (used when running as root) |
165: 
166: ## Quick Error Reference
167: 
168: | Error | Fix |
169: |-------|-----|
170: | Tilted/diagonal bounding boxes | Parser struct not zero-initialized — use `NvDsInferObjectDetectionInfo obj = {};` |
171: | Zero KITTI files | `gie-kitti-output-dir` not read by nvinfer — use `ds-kitti-dump.sh` (wraps `deepstream-app`) |
172: | Engine rebuilds every DS run | `model-engine-file` path wrong — check relative path from `config/` dir |
173: | `setDimensions` negative dims | Add `infer-dims=3;H;W` to nvinfer config for dynamic ONNX models |
174: | `--memPoolSize` workspace 0.03 MiB | Use `M` suffix not `MiB` — e.g. `--memPoolSize=workspace:32768M` |
175: | ForeignNode build failure (DETR) | Use dynamo export path or run `onnxsim` — see references/engine-build.md |
176: | Zero detections | Wrong `net-scale-factor` — check model family table in references/pipeline-run.md |
177: | `No module named 'pyservicemaker'` | Install into venv: `pip install /opt/nvidia/deepstream/.../pyservicemaker*.whl` |

2: # NV Engine Build -- Steps 4-5
3: 
4: Build a TensorRT engine from ONNX and derive PEAK_GPU_STREAMS for DeepStream sizing.
5: 
6: The ONNX model path is: `$ARGUMENTS`
7: 
8: ## Pre-flight: Validate Inputs and Extract Variables
9: 
10: Before anything else, derive all variables from `$ARGUMENTS` and verify the environment:
11: ```bash
12: ONNX_PATH="$ARGUMENTS"
13: 
14: # Derive MODEL_NAME from directory structure: models/{MODEL_NAME}/model/...
15: MODEL_NAME=$(echo "$ONNX_PATH" | sed 's|models/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|')
16: 
17: # Derive MODEL_FILENAME as the ONNX basename without extension
18: MODEL_FILENAME=$(basename "$ONNX_PATH" .onnx)
19: 
20: # MAX_BS drives --optShapes, --maxShapes, and the engine filename postfix
21: # Starting value is 64 — will double iteratively in Step 5 if PEAK_GPU_STREAMS > 64
22: MAX_BS=64
23: 
24: echo "Model:    $MODEL_NAME"
25: echo "File:     $MODEL_FILENAME"
26: echo "ONNX:     $ONNX_PATH"
27: echo "Engine:   models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines/${MODEL_FILENAME}_dynamic_b${MAX_BS}.engine"
28: 
29: # Verify ONNX file exists
30: ls -lh "$ONNX_PATH" || { echo "ERROR: ONNX file not found at $ONNX_PATH"; exit 1; }
31: 
32: # Verify trtexec is available and check TRT version
33: TRTEXEC=$(which trtexec) || { echo "ERROR: trtexec not found in PATH — install TensorRT or check PATH"; exit 1; }
34: $TRTEXEC --help 2>&1 | head -3
35: dpkg -l | grep libnvinfer-bin
36: 
37: # Verify GPU is available
38: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv,noheader
39: ```
40: 
41: If the ONNX file doesn't exist, inform the user to run Steps 1-3 first (see references/model-acquire.md).
42: 
43: > All subsequent commands use `$MODEL_NAME`, `$MODEL_FILENAME`, `$MAX_BS`, and `$TRTEXEC` — never hardcoded paths or template placeholders.
44: 
45: Inspect the ONNX model and auto-parse input name and spatial dimensions:
46: ```bash
47: INSPECT_OUT=$(python3 skills/deepstream-import-vision-model/scripts/model/inspect-onnx.py "$ONNX_PATH")
48: echo "$INSPECT_OUT"
49: 
50: INPUT_NAME=$(echo "$INSPECT_OUT" | grep -oP 'input_name:\s*\K\S+')
51: H=$(echo "$INSPECT_OUT"          | grep -oP 'height:\s*\K[0-9]+')
52: W=$(echo "$INSPECT_OUT"          | grep -oP 'width:\s*\K[0-9]+')
53: 
54: echo "INPUT_NAME=$INPUT_NAME  H=$H  W=$W"
55: [ -z "$INPUT_NAME" ] && { echo "ERROR: could not parse INPUT_NAME from inspect output"; exit 1; }
56: # If H/W are empty (dynamic spatial dims), set them manually before proceeding:
57: #   H=640; W=640   # or whatever the model's expected input resolution is
58: #   Check the model card on HuggingFace or config.json image_size field
59: [ -z "$H" ] && { echo "ERROR: H not detected — model has dynamic spatial dims. Set H manually: H=<height>"; exit 1; }
60: [ -z "$W" ] && { echo "ERROR: W not detected — model has dynamic spatial dims. Set W manually: W=<width>";  exit 1; }
61: ```
62: 
63: ## Step 4: Build TensorRT Engine
64: 
65: Build one dynamic engine optimized for BS=64. `opt=max=64` ensures TRT optimizes kernels for
66: the exact batch size used for benchmarking and DeepStream. `min=1` handles single-stream validation.
67: 
68: ```bash
69: STEP4_START=$(date +%s.%N)
70: TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
71: # benchmarks/engines/ already exists from nv-model-acquire;
72: # mkdir -p kept here as a safety net for standalone use
73: mkdir -p models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/b1 models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/b${MAX_BS}
74: 
75: $TRTEXEC \
76:   --onnx="$ONNX_PATH" \
77:   --minShapes=$INPUT_NAME:1x3x${H}x${W} \
78:   --optShapes=$INPUT_NAME:${MAX_BS}x3x${H}x${W} \
79:   --maxShapes=$INPUT_NAME:${MAX_BS}x3x${H}x${W} \
80:   --fp16 \
81:   --skipInference \
82:   --memPoolSize=workspace:32768M \
83:   --timingCacheFile=models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines/timing.cache \
84:   --saveEngine="models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines/${MODEL_FILENAME}_dynamic_b${MAX_BS}.engine" \
85:   2>&1 | tee models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines/${MODEL_FILENAME}_dynamic_build_${TIMESTAMP}.log
86: 
87: # Verify engine was created — trtexec exit code is lost through the pipe, so check the file
88: [ -f "models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines/${MODEL_FILENAME}_dynamic_b${MAX_BS}.engine" ] || \
89:   { echo "ERROR: Engine file not created — check build log for errors"; exit 1; }
90: 
91: STEP4_END=$(date +%s.%N)
92: STEP4_DURATION=$(echo "$STEP4_END - $STEP4_START" | bc)
93: echo "[Step 4] Engine build completed in ${STEP4_DURATION}s"
94: ```
95: 
96: Set the ENGINE variable — used by all subsequent trtexec and DeepStream runs:
97: ```bash
98: ENGINE="models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/engines/${MODEL_FILENAME}_dynamic_b${MAX_BS}.engine"
99: ```
100: 
101: ## Step 5: Benchmark — 2 Runs Only
102: 
103: Run exactly **2 trtexec benchmarks** using the Step 4 engine. No sweep needed.
104: - BS=1 → latency baseline (single-stream worst case)
105: - BS=64 → peak throughput → `PEAK_GPU_STREAMS`
106: 
107: ```bash
108: STEP5_START=$(date +%s.%N)
109: ```
110: 
111: ### Run 5a — Latency baseline (BS=1)
112: 
113: > Log filename is **fixed** — no timestamp, no variation. Always `trtexec_b1.log`. This ensures the nv-import-vision-model-report skill can find it with an exact path, not a wildcard.
114: 
115: ```bash
116: $TRTEXEC \
117:   --loadEngine="$ENGINE" \
118:   --shapes=$INPUT_NAME:1x3x${H}x${W} \
119:   --noDataTransfers --duration=10 --warmUp=1000 \
120:   2>&1 | tee models/$MODEL_NAME/benchmarks/b1/trtexec_b1.log
121: ```
122: 
123: ### Run 5b — Peak throughput (BS=MAX_BS)
124: 
125: > Log filename is **fixed** — always `trtexec_b${MAX_BS}.log`. Updated by the while loop if MAX_BS changes.
126: 
127: ```bash
128: $TRTEXEC \
129:   --loadEngine="$ENGINE" \
